phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.description: Reborn from ash, the Phoenix rules Fire Ridge's thermal vents. Its heat signatures attract the Deep Water Serpent during volcanic eruptions.

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.description: The Dragon descends from Fire Ridge to hunt in Deep Water, creating a bridge between fire and ocean biomes.

jellyfish.name: Jellyfish
jellyfish.description: Bioluminescent Jellyfish drift in Deep Water currents, their glow guiding the Octopus through dark underwater cave passages.

octopus.name: Octopus
octopus.description: The Octopus explores underwater tunnels leading to Crystal Caves, where it hunts Crystal Spiders that wandered too close to the water's edge.

koi_fish.name: Koi Fish
koi_fish.description: Koi Fish swim through underground rivers connecting Deep Water to Crystal Caves, where they cross paths with drinking Crystal Deer.

serpent.name: Serpent
serpent.description: The Serpent is Deep Water's apex predator, but during eruptions it surfaces near Fire Ridge, drawn by the Phoenix's heat — and hunted by the Dragon.

crystal_deer.name: Crystal Deer
crystal_deer.description: Crystal Deer drink from underground springs fed by Deep Water, sharing the water's edge with Koi Fish and visiting Geometric Turtles in the Forest.

crystal_spider.name: Crystal Spider
crystal_spider.description: Crystal Spiders spin webs in cave entrances, catching Crystal Butterflies. But they fall prey to Octopuses from below and Geometric Owls from the Forest above.

crystal_butterfly.name: Crystal Butterfly
crystal_butterfly.description: Crystal Butterflies pollinate crystal formations, protected by the presence of Crystal Deer whose antlers they rest upon.

geometric_owl.name: Geometric Owl
geometric_owl.description: The Geometric Owl hunts at the Forest-Crystal Caves boundary, preying on Crystal Spiders. The Clockwork Fox follows it curiously.

geometric_turtle.name: Geometric Turtle
geometric_turtle.description: Geometric Turtles migrate to Deep Water edges to lay eggs, where they meet Crystal Deer and Koi Fish at the shared water-forest-crystal nexus.

clockwork_fox.name: Clockwork Fox
clockwork_fox.description: The Clockwork Fox roams the Forest-Mechanical boundary, following Geometric Owls and occasionally meeting Mecha Beetles who forage in the forest.

mecha_scorpion.name: Mecha Scorpion
mecha_scorpion.description: Mecha Scorpions mine crystals from the Crystal Caves, creating a Mechanical-Crystal connection. Their excavations sometimes startle Crystal Deer.

mecha_beetle.name: Mecha Beetle
mecha_beetle.description: Mecha Beetles forage in the Forest for organic material, where they cross paths with the Clockwork Fox who investigates them with mechanical curiosity.

robo_dragonfly.name: Robo Dragonfly
robo_dragonfly.description: Robo Dragonflies skim the Deep Water surface, their sensors reading the same bioluminescent patterns as the Jellyfish below, creating a Mechanical-Water data link.

cinder_fox.desc: A small vulpine creature with fur of living embers, prowling ash slopes of Fire Ridge.

lava_salamander.desc: An amphibian adapted to molten rock pools, storing thermal energy in crystalline skin.

ash_moth.desc: A delicate lepidopteran with ash-grey wings and glowing ember-veins, primary prey of Fire Ridge.

abyssal_anglerfish.desc: A deep-sea predator with a bioluminescent lure that attracts prey from the abyssal darkness.

void_eel.desc: A serpentine creature of the void currents, glowing with violet bioluminescence as it drifts through darkness.

tidal_hydra.desc: A three-headed aquatic hydra that commands tidal currents, each head hunting independently yet sharing one consciousness.

geode_tortoise.desc: A tortoise whose shell is a geode of living crystals, growing gem clusters across its back as it ages. It shares crystal grazing grounds with the Crystal Deer.

prism_dragon.desc: A dragon whose scales refract light into rainbow spectra, bending the very fabric of perception. It hunts in the Crystal Caves and competes with the Tidal Hydra across biomes.

gem_wasp.desc: A wasp with a gemstone abdomen, harvesting crystal nectar to build its hive. Its crystalline stinger refracts light into piercing beams.

moss_bear.name: Moss Bear
moss_bear.description: The Moss Bear roams the deepest parts of the Forest, its fur interwoven with living moss and lichen. It feeds on Vine Serpents and shares territory with the Geometric Owl.

vine_serpent.name: Vine Serpent
vine_serpent.description: A slender serpent entwined with living vines, the Vine Serpent slithers through the undergrowth. Preyed upon by the Moss Bear, it competes with the Geometric Turtle for forest floor resources.

lantern_moth.name: Lantern Moth
lantern_moth.description: The Lantern Moth glows with bioluminescent light, guiding night travelers through the Forest. It forms a symbiotic bond with the Clockwork Fox and crosses into Crystal Caves to visit the Prism Dragon.

steam_centipede.name: Steam Centipede
steam_centipede.description: A multi-segmented mechanical centipede powered by internal steam boilers. Each segment houses a tiny furnace, and glowing vents release excess pressure. It crawls through the Mechanical biome's pipelines, maintaining the intricate gearwork.

gear_golem.name: Gear Golem
gear_golem.description: A towering automaton built from interlocking gears and brass plates. The Gear Golem serves as the guardian of the Mechanical biome, its internal clockwork heart driving massive arms capable of reshaping the terrain.
